title: Read the toy gridworld environment report
description: You inspect the version, platform, and Colab check.

steps.description: You import the listed modules and print the first part of sys.version. The recorded version is 3.12.16.
You print platform.platform() to describe the runtime environment. The recorded platform string begins with Linux.

steps.question: Which condition produces the Colab flag?
steps.answer: It checks whether google.colab is present in sys.modules. The recording prints False.

steps.description: You finish with the Colab field and two optional package-installation comments. The recorded output contains the three environment fields.
